about: Expected results from @aibvf/core, the TypeScript engine. Every AI BVF engine reproduces them: same inputs, same verdict, same score, same euros. Each case is [input, result]. The order of each result list is given in scripts/build-parity-vectors.mjs, which writes this file. Do not edit by hand.
